# Azumi’s right-arm injury performance

Azumi performed **accident-05-damage right arm** for mocapdata.com, Eyes, JAPAN Co. Ltd., © 2008–2009. The full BVH was converted to Humanoid FBX. The game uses seconds 25.12–26.69, retargeted to each archer, mirrored for the left arm and fitted for boot and forearm contact. The source and adapted motion clips retain the publisher’s Attribution–ShareAlike terms. The character models have separate licenses.

[Publisher](https://mocapdata.com/) · [Free motion terms](https://mocapdata.com/Terms_of_Use.html) · [CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.1/jp/).

## Hamada’s wrist support

Hamada performed **accident-05-damage right arm** for the same publisher. This FBX is the complete Humanoid conversion of the 120 Hz optical C3D take. The hand reaction uses the short excerpt around 14–17 seconds where Hamada brings the opposite hand under the wrist. It is mirrored for the left side. The C3D has no finger markers. The injured fingers use the bracing hand from **Getting Up**, credited separately in the Mixamo asset folder. The Eyes, JAPAN source and its adapted motion retain the license linked above.
